verdict.rationale: The evidence shows gstack ships as plain SKILL.md files in a public repo, installed by git clone and copy, with a dev mode that symlinks a checkout into .claude/skills/. Reading those files yourself is a user-side workaround that the plain-file layout happens to allow. No documented gstack feature lists a skill's instructions and scripts before install or presents every installed file for review.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward
